result.rationale: Defer the Sierra Railroad ownership correction while preserving the verified control and retained-investment evidence. Ridgewood's release proves a controlling acquisition and says Mike Hart retained a significant investment, but the complete post-close cap table, retained-holder roster and Sunburst passenger-operation perimeter are not directly disclosed. The existing Ridgewood-only owner representation therefore cannot yet be safely replaced with a complete after-image.
